alex_w: Heads up — noticed p99 token latency up ~18% on the FlashAttention path after yesterday's runtime tweak. Comparing commit 3a1f2d -> 4b2c3e.
maria_g: which variant? fused or paged?
alex_w: fused (fused-opt). KV-cache cold tails look worse. Staging benchmark: seq=2048, batch=8. p50 same, p99 310ms -> 366ms.
jordan_t: can you paste the perf summary?
alex_w: ```
Benchmark: infer_text
Model: redwood-7b
Seq: 2048
Batch: 8
Before(3a1f2d): p50=12.1ms p95=87.3ms p99=310.2ms
After(4b2c3e): p50=12.4ms p95=92.1ms p99=365.8ms
Route: kernel selector -> fused_flash
```
sam_k: did the kernel selector heuristics change? Might prefer fused more aggressively now.
maria_g: CI shows a selector tweak in 4b2c3e (line ~142) that biases fused for seq>1024.
perf-bot: flamegraph uploaded: https://perf.company/redwood/1945554321 — spike around cudaMemcpy + sync.
jordan_t: that sounds like KV-cache miss + fused kernel sync. Can you run an A/B forcing paged vs fused and toggling KV warm?
alex_w: quick A/B results: forced paged_flash p99=318ms, forced fused with kv=on p99=330ms, fused with kv=off p99=410ms. So fused seems much more sensitive to KV cold miss.
maria_g: interesting — selector change probably increased fused fallthroughs before KV warmed.
jordan_t: start a git bisect on runtime between the two commits to isolate selector vs kernel perf. Also run microkernel bench on both fused and paged.
alex_w: bisect started, current suspect 4b2c3e but need kernel microbench to be sure. Running microbench: small script that iterates seq=[512,1024,2048] and toggles kv-cache.
sam_k: I'll add a canary flag to force paged as a mitigation. feature-flag: attn_selector.force_paged -> canary namespace.
maria_g: will rollback selector bias in canary and start a 2-hour smoke test. Dumping traces to /var/log/infer/attn-traces-194555.log.
ci-bot: perf diff queued: https://ci.company/runs/98765 (will post results when done).
alex_w: action items: 1) rollback selector bias on canary (maria_g), 2) microkernel bench + flamegraphs (jordan_t), 3) add KV warmup/routing fallback (sam_k).
maria_g: rolling back now :thumbsup: will post when canary shows p99 < 330ms.
perf-bot: quick summary (from bench): fused shows 25% higher memcpy stalls on cold KV vs paged.
jordan_t: if bisect confirms selector change as primary, let's revert and add unit test to ensure selector doesn't flip pre-warm.
alex_w: noted. I'll leave the bisect running and attach logs once complete. Thanks everyone :eyes:
